title: Performance Benchmark: mirageV2 vs mirage
text: mirageV2 performance-oriented rewrite original mirage package. vignette benchmarks packages dataset compares results numerical equivalence.

title: Performance Benchmark: mirageV2 vs mirage
code: library(mirageV2)  toy <- read.csv(   system.file("extdata", "mirage_toy.csv", package = "mirageV2"),   stringsAsFactors = FALSE ) cat("Dataset:", nrow(toy), "variants across",     length(unique(toy$Gene)), "genes\n") #> Dataset: 1000 variants across 282 genes has_original <- requireNamespace("mirage", quietly = TRUE) cat("Original mirage installed:", has_original, "\n") #> Original mirage installed: TRUE

title: Performance Benchmark: mirageV2 vs mirage
code:
# Time mirageV2 t_v2 <- system.time(   res_v2 <- mirage(toy, n1 = 4315, n2 = 4315, verbose = FALSE) )  # Time original mirage t_v1 <- system.time(   res_v1 <- mirage::mirage(toy, n1 = 4315, n2 = 4315, verbose = FALSE) )  cat("
--- Timing Results ---

", t_v2["elapsed"])) #> mirageV2:           2.27s cat(sprintf("Speedup:            %.1fx
", t_v1["elapsed"] / t_v2["elapsed"])) #> Speedup:            38.2x # Original mirage not installed; benchmark mirageV2 alone t_v2 <- system.time(   res_v2 <- mirage(toy, n1 = 4315, n2 = 4315, verbose = FALSE) ) cat(sprintf("mirageV2: %.2fs

Mixture Model Based Rare Variant Analysis on Genes
Mixture Model Based Rare Variant Analysis on Genes
text: mirageV2 implements Bayesian mixture model original mirage. gene ii variants j=1,…,mij = 1, \ldots, m_i: variant modeled risk (Zij=1Z_{ij} = 1) non-risk (Zij=0Z_{ij} = 0) P(Zij=1∣Ui=1)=ηkP(Z_{ij} = 1 \mid U_i = 1) = \eta_k, kk variant’s annotation category. gene risk gene (Ui=1U_i = 1) probability δ\delta. Variant-level Bayes factors computed integrating Gamma-distributed relative risk parameter. Parameters (δ,η1,…,ηK)(\delta, \eta_1, \ldots, \eta_K) estimated via EM (Expectation-Maximization) log-space. Gene-level posterior probabilities likelihood ratio test p-values reported. See original mirage documentation full method details, Getting Started article usage walkthrough.

title: mirageV2 0.1.0
text: First release rewrite MIRAGE rare-variant association tests (Han et al., 2025). mirage() fits gene-level mixture model. mirage_vs() fits variant-set model. Variant Bayes factors computed C++ composite Simpson’s rule. EM algorithm runs log-space, convergence tracks delta eta. Reported Bayes factors stay finite, gene posteriors taken log-space EM fit. Results S3 objects print(), summary(), tidy(), .data.frame() methods. Inputs validated fit.
